_comment: Single source for the statement <-> Lean declaration map of paper_R5 (residue-APN, FFTA). Read by papers/blueprint/gen_blueprint.py and by the tables in STATEMENT_MAP.md. Optional key lean_defs: Lean definitions (not theorems) for a Def node. Trust labels as in apnlift TRUST.md: F = kernel-checked Lean 4, std-3 axioms; 'F (...) + M' = only the named part is formal; M = paper only; L = cited; Def / Rem. Status of the Lean tree is recorded separately (closed in the working tree / fresh build / lean4checker / vault).
lean_project: lean/residue_apn_portable (lib ResidueAPN); the development tree is recorded in lean/records/development

def:opt.note: definition; the Lean definitions are read against the paper in MEANING_MAP.md (every nonempty fibre has two elements = the fibre through each point has two elements).

lem:O.note: formal (stage 3, session R11) for every polynomial over F_2 with quadratic support (IsQuadSupp: exponents 0, 2^i, 2^i+2^j, i<j<m) over F = F_{2^m}, m odd; display (1) for F_2 coefficients is derivative_quadratic; gcd is EuclideanDomain.gcd in F_2[t] (its only unit is 1, so this is the monic gcd). The formal proof does not use a normal basis: #ker phi(sigma) = 2^(deg phi) for phi dividing t^m-1, from a root bound and #ker (phi psi)(sigma) <= #ker phi(sigma) #ker psi(sigma); ker kappa(sigma) = ker g(sigma) by Bezout. The hypothesis 'reduced' is not needed.

thm:A.note: all four items; Tr is written as the sum of Frobenius powers (absTr).

lem:LW.note: cited (Li-Wang, DCC 2011, Thm. 4); self-contained proof in the paper; not formalized. Not required: Section 3 comparison, not a dependency of the formal statements of A, B, C, R, W (GPT R7).

thm:B.note: formal: P' = g^l, P+1 = g^l E, g separable with 2^s roots in F_{2^{2s}} minus (F_{2^s} union F_q), gcd(g,E)=1 over F_2, P = 1 at the roots, multiplicity l as a root of P+1 and of P'. Paper only: reading these multiplicities as ramification indices / different exponents of P^1 -> P^1, the point at infinity (Riemann-Hurwitz), the fibre over 1.

rem:tit.note: remark with a computation; not formalized.

prop:C.note: the identity in Z[X] and its image in every commutative ring are formal; the operation count is paper only.

prop:lift.note: formal for every finite commutative ring R with a surjection pi onto F such that elements outside ker pi are units; that GR(2^k,m) is such a ring is paper level (Galois rings are not in Mathlib).

thm:R.note: (1) for pi(alpha) outside {0,1} = ker K; (2) for alpha in ker pi with annihilator ker pi (nonzero top-ideal elements of GR(2^k,m), k>=2); the count 2 q^(k-1) is 2 #(ker pi), and #R = #F #(ker pi). card_fibre: every fibre of pi has #(ker pi) elements. Paper only (GR_BRIDGE.md): the Galois-ring instance (B1-B4); the number (q-2)q^(k-1) of directions in (1), which is (q-2)#(ker pi) with #(ker pi) = q^(k-1); the RS-cited bounds after the theorem.

prop:W.note: the normalisation c p(rho x) before the proposition is a hypothesis of propW (Tr(p(y+1)+p(y)) = 1); the normalisation argument itself is paper only.
